meta.name: ai-amazon-return-reduction
meta.description: Amazon 退货诊断助手适合运营、产品、销售、software在用户提出“退货为什么变多”这类问题，需要快速拆解目标、判断重点并形成可执行结果时使用，帮助基于输入材料生成商品/店铺诊断、卖点与风险提示、运营动作建议。

copy.tagline: 诊断亚马逊退货原因并给出运营建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果负责亚马逊店铺运营，需要快速定位退货问题并制定改进方案。
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose Amazon return reasons and provide actionable suggestions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage an Amazon store and need to quickly identify return issues and improve performance.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成 Amazon 退货诊断助手。它能根据你提供的商品信息、店铺链接、评论等材料，分析退货原因，给出商品/店铺诊断、卖点与风险提示，以及运营动作建议。
howto.when: 当你提出“退货为什么变多”这类问题，并提供了运营目标、目标买家、商品链接或相关资料时触发。

say.text: 我的店铺退货率突然升高，帮我诊断一下原因。
分析这款商品的退货原因，并给出优化建议。
say.note: Claude 会基于你提供的商品信息进行分析。

say.text: 根据这些评论，总结退货风险和改进点。
say.note: Claude 会提取评论中的关键信息。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes an Amazon return reduction assistant. It analyzes provided materials (product info, store links, reviews, etc.) to diagnose return reasons, output product/store diagnosis, selling points & risk alerts, and operational action suggestions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask questions like 'Why are returns increasing?' and provide operational goals, target audience, product/store links, or related materials.

say_en.text: My store's return rate suddenly increased. Help me diagnose the cause.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for store link or materials, then generate a diagnosis report.

say_en.text: Analyze the return reasons for this product and give optimization suggestions.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze based on the product info you provide.

say_en.text: Summarize return risks and improvement points from these reviews.
say_en.note: Claude will extract key information from the reviews.
